title: Die natürliche Logarithmusfunktion als Stammfunktion von 1/x nutzen (LK)
description: Die lernende Person kann die natürliche Logarithmusfunktion als Stammfunktion von `1/x` verwenden und diese Beziehung in einfachen Integralrechnungen und Begründungen sicher nutzen.
checks: Inspected the actual candidate-v2 PNG, including boundary guides and integral formulas.
For x>0 the derivative of ln x is 1/x. The example integral from 1 to e equals ln e−ln1=1, and the warning distinguishes ∫1/x² dx=−1/x+C correctly.
The diagram now uses only the two integration boundaries 1 and e, with correct endpoint labels (1,1),(e,1/e). Shading is restricted to those boundaries and is labelled area=1.

The former competing 3 tick and decimal axis labels are absent. This is a schematic area illustration rather than a numerically calibrated plotting exercise; its remaining illustrative proportions do not change the correct antiderivative or area argument.
